clusters.name: pretooluse-review-mail-first
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single sequential cluster. Tests (US-002) depend on the code change (US-001), and the version bump + marketplace + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md note (US-003) must come last. Parallelizing would conflict on the plugin's six version stamps and the AGENTS/CHANGELOG prepends, so the work serializes by construction.
